swipeComponent.function:
component:GetVar("direction"):SetInt(1) component:GetVar("mode"):SetInt(1) component:GetVar("tSteps"):SetFloat(25.0) component:listenToTouches(element)
local numItems = element("NumGoals"):GetInt()
if(element:GetElement(element("FirstGoal"):GetString())) then local itemHeight = element:GetElement(element("FirstGoal"):GetString()):absH()
if((numItems*itemHeight) > (element:absH())) then component:setScrollSize((numItems*itemHeight) - (element:absH())) else component:setScrollSize(0) end end
swipeComponent.event: local offset = component:scrollOffset() local first = element:GetElement(element("FirstGoal"):GetString()) if first then if ( first:getOrientationPosition().y ~= offset ) then first:setOrientationPosition(Vector2(first("xOffset"):GetInt(), offset)) --[[local scrollMarker = element:parent():GetElement("ScrollMarker") local scrollBar = element:parent():GetElement("ScrollBar") local markerBookend = scrollBar("BookendSize"):GetInt() local markerOffset = markerBookend + (scrollBar:absH() - (2*markerBookend))*((-1)*offset/component:scrollSize()) markerOffset = clamp(markerOffset, markerBookend, (scrollBar:absH() - (2*markerBookend))) scrollMarker("yOffset"):SetInt(markerOffset)]] end end
